findings.TORQUE: Strong external counter-winding visible across front, side and rear. Existing wide facets turn with the ribs. Continuous architectural support retained; original heavy pointed crown unchanged.
findings.KNUCKLE_R01: Regional events pronounced, but repeated bulb/neck masses risk a beaded reading. No separate stacked components were created.
findings.KNUCKLE_R02: Smaller middle expansion and longer bindings improve continuity. Less aggressive silhouette than R01. The lighter upper crown is inherited from INFLECT G4.
findings.CONFLUX: Upper return visible in oblique and side. More central depth and a heavier V-shaped lip undermine the architectural hierarchy; stopped after R01 despite passed geometry checks.
findings.opening: One principal opening remains. Stronger turns increase projected body width and reduce aperture at some heights; preserved in measurements and not hidden by reframing. No usable-clearance certification.
findings.presentation: Same full-model camera target and scale, no full-model cropping, consistent lighting and actual geometry only. Labels sit outside renders. Section plots retain all protrusions at common XY scale. Public JPEGs preserve the same framing.
